punchline: Scrum plans the next sprint from what the team really finished in the last one.
thirty_sec: A summary of Sutherland's book says the FBI spent about $170 million over five years on a system that delivered nothing usable, then restarted with Scrum and delivered working pieces every few weeks. Part of the fix is to plan from what the team actually finished last sprint and to show remaining work on a public burndown chart.
